issues.what: DESIGN_NOTES L269 (Sound, Neural Lace Bus): lists 'The Lamp's private ethical voice (right ear...)' as carried by a bus, then says 'This bus does not speak'. Contradicts section 9 (no voice acting, bus is non-speech) and config L47, which was already corrected.

issues.what: DESIGN_NOTES L183 (Generational Operatives) says the new operative arrives '~15-30 years after the previous operative's extraction'. Section 4 (L389) and config L22 define 15-30 years BETWEEN operatives (4-6 yrs work before extraction + 11-24 after).
issues.fix: Change to 'arriving 11-24 years after extraction (15-30 years between operatives)'.

issues.what: Open-items labels collide with spine rule numbers: L81 'Text-only advisor / writing prototype (R5)' and L79 '(S1-R8)', L82 'route RC/R7', L79/80 '(R8)'. The Rules spine note (L93) says R1-R8 are the only rule numbers, but R5 here is a review route, not 'Emergency cardinality and fuse'. R8 does coincide with spine R8 (Epoch 1 definition of done), but R5 does not.
issues.fix: Relabel L81 as 'review route R5' (or drop it and rely on the traceability table). Say once in Open items that bare Rn there means the spine rule only where a rule of that number exists, or use S1-Rn throughout.

issues.what: Status index is overbroad. 'Core Rule: epoch-agnostic abstractions' and 'Visual & UI Direction' are marked shipped but contain planned clauses (insertion spends Delta, lab-save caveat, readability rule, later notes). The Core Rule section says the engine accepts EpochProfileBlueprint[] in the present tense, while 'Where facts live' says no epoch-ladder blueprint exists in code (grep confirms: only docs name it). Section 0 is marked planned but Clock 1 (60 Hz stepKinematics) is shipped.
issues.fix: Index: set Core Rule and Visual & UI to 'partial' with the planned roadmap ids; set section 0 to 'partial'. In the Core Rule section add 'planned' to the EpochProfileBlueprint[] sentence. C5 then splits shipped from planned paragraphs per system.

issues.what: Banners in sections 7 and 8 say 'Nothing here is shipped' but the same sections carry inline '(shipped)' tags (walkSpeedMetersPerSec, requestSetPortalState, update_prop_state, paused bit, hinge). L452 'This change clears an open or ajar threshold' is present tense next to '(shipped)' hinge text. The convention is not stated anywhere.
issues.fix: Reword banners: 'No behaviour described here is shipped. Names tagged (shipped) are existing code it builds on.' State the (shipped) tag convention once in the header. Rewrite L452 'This change' as 'The locomotion change'.

issues.what: config.yaml L31 (F3 debug mode) says in the present tense that debug mode 'Pauses ... watch advancement' and 'morphs the audio bus into a frozen room-tone grain'. issues.fix: Tag the watch-advancement and audio-morph clauses '(planned: 05b-1-watch-clock-and-time-spend, 05a-audio-engine)'. Add '(planned: 05a-audio-engine, audio-minimal)' to the Sound Design heading, same as DESIGN_NOTES.

issues.fix: Change to 'added by 05b-2-envelopes-and-gates (planned)'.

issues.what: Root AGENTS.md (not touched by C4) states as shipped: locomotionMode waypoint/direct and 'a direct body takes a steer', the 0.22 m disc and 0.03 m prop slop, arrival hold, Space proximity use and menu grammar, interactionHold, conversation paging and ambient lines, and npm run eval:ai. Route RC/R7 is the storylet-card question (authored versus generated cards), so it is both settled and open. Open items L82 repeats the same circularity.

issues.what: House style is verbose and repetitive. The banner sentence 'A direction with room to change (P5); read each verb as "will"' appears about 10 times (L189, 243, 310, 318, 326, 447, 464, 478, 486, 497, 509, 539, 583, 592); config repeats '[planned - revisable]' 10 times (L35-44); (planned: ...) marks nest two or three per paragraph; headings run past 150 characters; review ids (S1-R5, S2-12, S5-11, S2-05, S4-10, INV-x) sit inline in design prose.
